# PyPI package-store fixtures

The byte literals in `test/contracts/Ecluse/Test/Contract/PackageStore/PyPI/Fixtures.hs` are the only archive-data copies.
These six archives contain independent Core Metadata for two versions.
Each version has two wheel filenames and one source distribution.
The metadata uses a distinct `Requires-Python` value for every file.
The same module pins six expected SHA-256 digests independently of the production publisher.

The test uses `BS.pack` literals, so discovery performs no archive generation or file reads.
These archives exercise metadata extraction. They are not installer fixtures.

Run the following check with Python 3.13.15 from the repository root.
It recreates the archives and checks literal bytes, digests, extracted metadata and fixed timestamps.
For an intentional fixture change, set `regenerate = True` and copy the printed declarations into the module.
Update the reviewed digest and metadata literals and run the check again.
The standard library is needed only for regeneration, not for builds or test execution.
The existing E2E builders use Python ZIP and native tar generation too.
Their runtime IO does not fit pure contract discovery.

```python
import gzip, hashlib, io, re, tarfile, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
source = Path('test/contracts/Ecluse/Test/Contract/PackageStore/PyPI/Fixtures.hs').read_text()
regenerate = False
bindings = iter(['primarySdistBytes', 'primaryUniversalWheelBytes', 'primaryPythonWheelBytes',
                 'siblingSdistBytes', 'siblingUniversalWheelBytes', 'siblingPythonWheelBytes'])
checked = []
for version, requirements in [('1.0.0', ['>=3.8', '>=3.9', '>=3.10']), ('2.0.0', ['>=3.11', '>=3.12', '>=3.13'])]:
    for tag, requirement in zip(['sdist', 'py2.py3-none-any', 'py3-none-any'], requirements):
        metadata = f'Metadata-Version: 2.4\nName: contract-package\nVersion: {version}\nRequires-Python: {requirement}\nSummary: {version} {tag}\n\n'.encode()
        data=io.BytesIO()
        if tag == 'sdist':
            filename=f'contract-package-{version}.tar.gz'
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=data, mode='w', format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT) as archive:
                entry=tarfile.TarInfo(f'contract-package-{version}/PKG-INFO')
                entry.size=len(metadata)
                entry.mtime=0
                entry.mode=0o644
                archive.addfile(entry, io.BytesIO(metadata))
            payload=gzip.compress(data.getvalue(), mtime=0)
        else:
            filename=f'contract_package-{version}-{tag}.whl'
            with zipfile.ZipFile(data, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_STORED) as archive:
                entry=zipfile.ZipInfo(f'contract_package-{version}.dist-info/METADATA', (2026,1,1,0,0,0))
                entry.external_attr=0o644 << 16
                archive.writestr(entry,metadata)
            payload=data.getvalue()
        binding = next(bindings)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
        if regenerate:
            print(binding + ' :: ByteString')
            print(binding + ' = BS.pack [' + ', '.join(f'0x{byte:02x}' for byte in payload) + ']')
            print(filename, digest)
            continue
        match = re.search(rf'{binding} = BS.pack \[(.*?)\]', source, re.S)
        assert match, binding
        stored = bytes(int(value.strip(), 0) for value in match[1].split(','))
        pinned = re.search(rf'PackageStoreArtifact "{re.escape(filename)}"\s+{binding}\s+"([0-9a-f]+)"', source)
        assert pinned and hashlib.sha256(stored).hexdigest() == pinned[1], filename
        assert stored == payload, filename
        if tag == 'sdist':
            assert stored[4:8] == bytes(4)
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(stored), mode='r:gz') as archive:
                entry, = archive.getmembers()
                assert entry.mtime == entry.uid == entry.gid == 0
                extracted = archive.extractfile(entry).read()
        else:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(stored)) as archive:
                entry, = archive.infolist()
                assert entry.date_time == (2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
                extracted = archive.read(entry)
        assert extracted == metadata, filename
        checked.append(requirement)
if not regenerate:
    assert len(checked) == len(set(checked)) == 6
    print('Six literal archives match their regenerated bytes, pinned digests, metadata and timestamps.')
```
